payload.text: The which --json contract, version 1, is final (2026-11-13 07:27Z): the shape from ic, the meanings from cc (headroom in percent of the weekly allowance, scoped windows with their share) and the yes from vc, with the clarification from ic that an unknown account still reports its last-seen percent and reset. vc gave it to geodica-estate, its first reader, the same minute. With cc's tightening at ST0002/WP02, soonest is null when no usable account's weekly window gives a reset; version 1 stands, because a null soonest was already possible and nothing had emitted the JSON, and vc told geodica-estate. ic fixes the contract in a test at ST0002/WP03 and documents it at WP07; changing it now raises its version.
